Welcome to ⚽ Soccer League
💰Play every day for a +10% money boost! Missing a day resets the money boost to 1.0x
🆓Get a free Headless dance emote when you join Sports League group!

UPDATED
1. Settings menu
-Ball highlight setting
-Field of view setting
-Keybind settings
-etc...
2. Physics based goalkeeper dive
3. Ball spectating
4. Fixed gamepasses
5. Fixed lag
6. Fixed bugs

✨ PRO STRATS
Use slide tackle to steal the ball!
Pass to teammates to get past the blockers team!
Kick to the corner of the goal to score!
Win the match and celebrate!

🎮 GAME
Football/Soccer is all about teamwork! Make sure to pass to teammates to score goals and win the world cup!

Inspired by TPS: Street Soccer. Lots of new features are coming soon!✨
